name: Line Chart
description: One line over a soft water area in a card, smooth or straight, with a crosshair tooltip.

props.name: data
props.description: One value per label. A new data set is revealed again from the left.

props.name: labels
props.description: One label per point along the bottom. Crowded labels thin out.

props.name: curve
props.description: Bend through the points without overshooting, or join them with straight lines.

props.name: baseline
props.description: Where the value axis starts. The default of 0 keeps proportions honest; "auto" starts just under the lowest value, which suits a series that sits far above zero, such as a balance or a pressure reading.

props.name: name
props.description: What the values are, shown in the tooltip. Defaults to the card label.

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in pixels. The width follows the card.

props.name: format
props.description: Writes values in the tooltip. Defaults to grouped whole numbers.

props.name: formatAxis
props.description: Writes the tick labels on the left. Defaults to compact numbers such as 1.5M.

props.name: titles
props.description: Longer names for the tooltip title, one per label.

props.name: xLabel
props.description: A title under the horizontal axis. The chart makes room for it.

props.name: yLabel
props.description: A title beside the vertical axis, set sideways. The chart makes room for it.

props.name: summary
props.description: What the chart shows, for screen readers. Generated from the data when left out.

props.name: label
props.description: Small muted label at the top of the card.

props.name: delta
props.description: Change as a signed fraction, shown as a chip beside the value.

props.name: action
props.description: A control on the right of the header, such as a segmented control that swaps the data set.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card, e.g. a width. Also accepts caption, note, invertDelta and every other prop of a div.
